description: This is a Java Spring MVC Controller class handling product keyword management in an e-commerce application. It includes methods for displaying, adding, removing, and paging keywords associated with a product, along with necessary security and validation logic.

classes.name: ProductKeywordsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing product keywords (tags) including CRUD operations and pagination.

methods.name: displayKeywords
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product keywords management page for a specific product.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new keyword/tag to a product in a specific language.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX request to remove a specific keyword/tag from a product.

methods.name: pageKeywords
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX request to retrieve a paginated list of keywords for a product.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up menu context for views.
